title: Mummy and Demon Guardians
description: A bandaged mummy warrior with glowing purple eyes stands in the foreground holding two ornate silver shields, wearing purple and gold armor pieces. Behind him to the left is a muscular blue demon with large black horns and glowing red eyes, standing between two tattered black and red banners inside a cracked stone archway.
prompt: A powerful mummy warrior with glowing purple eyes and detailed bandages stands in the center holding two silver shields, wearing purple and gold armor. To his left is a muscular blue demon with large black horns and glowing red eyes. They stand in a crumbling stone archway with two tattered black and red banners. Behind them is a massive glowing cosmic spiral portal filled with arcane symbols and stars in a dark nebula sky, dramatic fantasy lighting.
